items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Dennis played with them out there' and Interviewee responds 'Oh yeah, yeah. He went with, he was out there.' without claiming personal collaboration or direct interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah, some old-time pictures of them. Chris got them out there. Yeah, who,
And when we left them here, we killed them. And the lambs on them was in the band. Uh, Dennis played with them out there. Who? Dennis, he did. Oh yeah, yeah. He went with, he was out there. And uh.
Was Alfred William out there with them? I know, no. I know Alfred played with. But uh.
